name: unifit
expr: [a_b, b_b, aci_b, bci_b] = unifit(x); [a_a, b_a, aci_a, bci_a] = unifit(x, 0.01); [a_one, b_one, aci_one, bci_one] = unifit(xone);
comment: Sig: [a, b, aci, bci] = unifit(x[, alpha]). MLE for U(a,b): a=min, b=max. CI extension delta = (b-a)·(α^(-1/n) − 1). Single-element x: ACI=BCI=[x x] (zero-width). Empty input: numkit returns NaN; MATLAB returns empty arrays — convention difference, not in fingerprint.
